speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. Given your history of gait and limb ataxia, I need to understand the timing and progression of your symptoms. Have you noticed any progressive worsening of your balance over the past few years, or did this start suddenly?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the "drunken" gait and right-sided clumsiness are concerning for cerebellar involvement. To determine if this is due to a tumor, degeneration like spinocerebellar ataxia, or a vascular event, could you tell me if you have experienced any nausea, vomiting, double vision, or difficulty speaking recently? Also, do you have a family history of similar walking difficulties or neurological issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a crucial detail; natalizumab is rarely used for Crohn's but is a first-line treatment for Multiple Sclerosis. Did you receive this medication specifically for suspected MS, and have you noticed any episodes of vision loss or numbness in your limbs recently?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast
REQUEST TEST: Anti-MOG and Anti-NMO antibody panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain Findings: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML. Anti-MOG and Anti-NMO antibody panel: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. Given the MRI findings of non-enhancing demyelinating lesions and your history of natalizumab use, I am discontinuing the medication immediately. Do you have any new onset headaches, fever, or confusion that might suggest the infection is progressing rapidly?
